10-prompt-engineering.title: Prompt engineering
10-prompt-engineering.intro: Communicate tasks, examples and constraints to models, then evaluate prompt changes.
10-prompt-engineering.practice: Compare two prompts on the same cases, stating a success criterion and a failure case.

20-rag.title: RAG
20-rag.intro: Build retrieval pipelines whose answers can be traced to relevant, permitted evidence.
20-rag.practice: Produce a claim-to-evidence table and explain one justified abstention.

30-agents.title: Agents
30-agents.intro: Build tool-using systems with explicit state, context and execution controls.
30-agents.practice: Draw one tool-call loop and identify validation, permissions and stopping conditions.

40-automation.title: Automation & agent frameworks
40-automation.intro: Implement workflows and agents with clear contracts, persistence and recovery.
40-automation.practice: Specify what must survive a crash and test recovery after one side effect.

50-fine-tuning.title: Fine-tuning
50-fine-tuning.intro: Decide when to adapt a model, then diagnose training and evaluate the result.
50-fine-tuning.practice: Compare adaptation with a simpler baseline and define a held-out evaluation.

60-llm-inference.title: LLM inference
60-llm-inference.intro: Understand serving mechanics, measure quality and latency, and plan capacity under load.
60-llm-inference.practice: Define a representative workload and a quality, latency and cost acceptance criterion.

70-containers-infra.title: Containers & infrastructure
70-containers-infra.intro: Package and run model workloads using containers, GPUs and deployment runtimes.
70-containers-infra.practice: Explain the image, runtime, driver and model-weight responsibilities in a deployment.

80-api-layer-routing.title: API layer & routing
80-api-layer-routing.intro: Route model requests through reliable gateways and application interfaces.
80-api-layer-routing.practice: Trace one request through authentication, routing, streaming and an error path.

90-observability-evals.title: Observability & evaluations
90-observability-evals.intro: Observe application behavior and evaluate quality with reproducible evidence.
90-observability-evals.practice: Define a rubric and compare two versions on paired cases, including failure analysis.

100-security-guardrails.title: Security & guardrails
100-security-guardrails.intro: Protect LLM applications and agents through runtime controls and tested defenses.
100-security-guardrails.practice: Trace an untrusted input to a protected resource and test the boundary that blocks it.

110-mlops-cicd.title: MLOps & CI/CD
110-mlops-cicd.intro: Deliver models and AI applications through reproducible training, releases and operations.
110-mlops-cicd.practice: Describe a versioned release, its promotion gate and a tested rollback procedure.

120-costs-finops.title: Costs & FinOps
120-costs-finops.intro: Measure and control AI costs while preserving task quality and service requirements.
120-costs-finops.practice: Calculate cost per successful task, including retries and fixed capacity assumptions.

130-llm-fundamentals.title: LLM fundamentals
130-llm-fundamentals.intro: Understand model representations and computation before choosing application techniques.
130-llm-fundamentals.practice: Explain how text becomes tokens, representations and generated output; identify the cost of context.

140-system-design-product.title: System design & product
140-system-design-product.intro: Design AI applications around product requirements, failure modes and operational ownership.
140-system-design-product.practice: Write an architecture decision with a baseline, constraints, failure handling and acceptance criteria.

150-data-compliance.title: Data & compliance
150-data-compliance.intro: Build reliable data flows with explicit schemas, time semantics, quality and governance.
150-data-compliance.practice: Define a data contract and reconstruct only the information available at prediction time.

160-multimodal-edge.title: Multimodal & edge
160-multimodal-edge.intro: Work with images, documents, voice and local models using task-specific evaluations.
160-multimodal-edge.practice: Choose an evaluation unit and explain a failure that aggregate accuracy would hide.

170-classical-ml.title: Classical ML & validation
170-classical-ml.intro: Select and validate predictive models, then reason about uncertainty and decisions.
170-classical-ml.practice: Choose a baseline, leakage-safe split and decision metric for one prediction task.
